term: exact binary truth and behavioral scoring
definition: Truthful target belief means the belief bit equals the target at every input. Successful response is a different notion defined through act. A behavioral score is an arbitrary Nat-valued function on the whole Boolean-input response function; the certificate proves its value identical for the displayed profiles. No counting distribution or likelihood on cognitive systems is supplied.
note: Exact all-state truth is deliberately stronger than approximate or probabilistic reliability. A Nat score is an analyst proxy; no empirical reproductive fitness or epistemic warrant interpretation is established.
